lesson: Use a relative acceptance test for balls: an absolute floor made 256-bit balls containing 0 count as decided. A hold-out read at one fixed threshold hides nodes that pass at another, and held-out positives repeating the zeta kernel do not test one-signedness; A-only families need a full character set.
